title: Cost Anomaly to Verified Savings
description: Detect cloud-cost anomalies, propose evidence-backed rightsizing, prepare approved IaC changes, and verify realized savings and service health.
setup_prompt: Use Cost Anomaly to Verified Savings for my authorized cloud scope. Preserve my billing basis, ownership, reliability limits, IaC workflow, and approval policy; detect and explain anomalies, prepare a concrete rightsizing diff, apply only after approval, and verify actual savings and service health.

setup_inputs.label: Authorized cloud accounts, projects, subscriptions, and environments
Billing basis, currency, attribution, budgets, and baseline policy
Utilization, demand, capacity, and service-health signals
Service, team, and resource ownership mapping
IaC repositories, state ownership, validation, deployment, and rollback path
Allowed optimizations, risk limits, approvals, and maintenance windows
Post-change health and savings verification window

recommended_tools.name: Cloud billing MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Read authorized cost, usage, pricing, commitment, credit, and attribution data

recommended_tools.name: Cloud monitoring MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Read authorized utilization, demand, capacity, error, latency, and service-health signals

recommended_tools.name: Terraform or OpenTofu CLI
recommended_tools.purpose: Prepare and validate reviewable infrastructure-as-code rightsizing changes

recommended_tools.name: Source-control MCP or CLI
recommended_tools.purpose: Create an authorized branch or pull request and retain review/change receipts

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks schedules
recommended_tools.purpose: Run anomaly detection and post-change verification at approved intervals

outputs: Versioned FinOps scope, baseline, and change policy
Evidence-backed cost anomaly and cause classification
Rightsizing candidate with cost, utilization, capacity, and risk evidence
Projected and verified savings with post-change service-health evidence
